purpose: Provenance and accuracy review for recognisable keypad styles and eight new omission/reinstatement exercises. The original 0.3.0 audit remains in keypad-practice.json.

scope.visuals: HTML/CSS style references to named physical keypads, with covers open where applicable. Not exact firmware or complete product emulation.
scope.fixture: One fictional ordinary intruder PIR zone per profile.
scope.disableMeaning: Omit the detector's zone; do not power off, disconnect or permanently decommission hardware.
scope.access: Each lesson starts after the relevant user or engineer authorisation. No real credentials, panel transport or live commands are present.

profiles.recognition: Tall ivory case, inset green LCD, round four-column keypad with A, B, ent and esc at the right.
profiles.session: Existing authorised full-menu context; 10 Setting contains 11 Omit Zones.
profiles.omit: Browse only eligible zones with A/B, select Hall PIR 1002, press #, then esc.
profiles.restore: Return to the same list and toggle # again, then esc.
profiles.behaviour: # applies immediately; esc retains the chosen state. ent starts setting on the real panel and is explicitly outside this lesson.
profiles.limits: Standard zones reinstate on unset. Vibration and ATM rules differ. The source includes zone tamper in omission, so the trainer makes no universal claim that omitted tampers remain active.

sources.title: Galaxy Dimension User Guide
sources.provenance: Manufacturer-authored PDF on public archive; Quick Menu numbering is not mixed into the Full Menu exercise

profiles.recognition: Black display bezel, blue LCD, oval keys, Yes/0/No bottom numeric row and separate Omit/Reset/Chime/Part/Area/Menu controls.
profiles.session: Separate authorised user prompt. Omission is not inserted into Engineer Utils.
profiles.omit: Press Omit, choose zone 002, press Omit, then Menu.
profiles.restore: Repeat on the same zone to remove its leading omission star, then Menu.
profiles.behaviour: The right-hand star marks eligibility; the left-hand star marks omission. Menu and No remain distinct controls.
profiles.limits: Normal disarm reinstatement can be changed by installer programming. The distinct 24-hour omission route and Engineer Diagnostic Omit are excluded.

sources.title: Premier Elite Series Master User Guide
sources.provenance: Manufacturer-hosted original; p7 identifies the physical layout, p23 supports this lesson, p26 distinguishes the excluded 24-hour route

profiles.recognition: Grey bezel, navigation cluster below LCD, cross/tick/menu keys, A-D setting column and numeric keypad to the right.
profiles.session: Separate authorised User menu. Existing Installer exercises retain their v6 guide context.
profiles.omit: Select Omit Zones, browse to zone 002, change I to O with right arrow, then tick to store.
profiles.restore: Change O to I with right arrow and tick to store.
profiles.behaviour: Only eligible zones are listed. A changed marker is a draft until tick; the lesson cannot complete before storing.
profiles.limits: The guide says normal operation resumes on unset. FINDR's Back discards unconfirmed drafts; that bounded trainer rule is labelled and not asserted as a sourced firmware behaviour.

sources.title: i-on Series User Guide
sources.provenance: Official manufacturer-hosted original; this user route is kept distinct from the named v6 Installer guide

profiles.panel: Legacy CP-25 / CP-50 for omission lessons
profiles.recognition: Wide metal face, black bezel and blue LCD, Enter/0/Clear bottom numeric row, Arm/Part/Area/Omit column and diamond arrow cluster.
profiles.omit: Select Omit zones, choose zone 02, toggle to tick with left/right, then Back.
profiles.restore: Toggle the same zone to cross, then Back.
profiles.behaviour: Tick means omitted; cross means monitored; -- marks an ineligible zone.
profiles.limits: Automatic reinstatement depends on the installer option. Omission source covers CP-25/CP-50; existing CP-100 engineer exercises do not extend this user lesson to every CP model.

sources.title: CP-25 / CP-50 / CP-100 Installation Manual
sources.provenance: Manufacturer-authored PDF; names the supported MK-700 keypad

reviewedCorrections: Each physical model is explicitly named and linked to the manufacturer reference; model appearance does not imply identical firmware.
The old generic keypad rendering is replaced with separate per-model arrangements, including Texecom Omit and the Orisec navigation cluster.
User omission roots are separate from engineer menus. Existing engineer routes and task IDs are preserved.
Ineligible zones cannot be omitted; Galaxy and Scantronic lists filter them out.
Texecom incomplete numeric entry cannot toggle the previously displayed zone.
Omission changes remain separate from detector electrical status and zone type.
Texecom Ready follows secure detector fixtures rather than login state; its Omit LED follows the simulated omission state.
Restoration has an explicit paired task and starts with the target zone omitted.
Stale limitations stating no simulated omission were revised; electrical shutdown and special-zone behaviours are not implied.
verificationBoundary: This audit reviews manufacturer evidence and source behaviour. Browser layout, build, APK packaging and deployment verification are performed by the release owner. No physical keypad or panel was connected.

automatedTests.coverage: 27 complete exercise routes, omission edge cases, previous practice behaviours, Safari cache and launch recovery

releaseValidation.browserPreview: Desktop chooser and Galaxy omit/restore; 390px frame for Texecom, Scantronic and Orisec omit flows; pending vs saved indication and both mobile jump controls checked.
releaseValidation.limits: Browser preview does not provide service workers. No physical iPhone, Android or real alarm panel was tested.
